title: Example direction
intent: Give operators a distinctive evidence-first review experience.

observed_signals: The requested output is an interactive product surface.
modality_assessment.rationale: The work changes an operational interface.

preserve: Keep the operator review path direct and evidence-led.
direction_count_basis: The evidence-first intent is clear enough for one selectable recommendation; uncertainties move into contrast studies.

directions.name: Proof Rail
directions.summary: Make the relationship between every consequential claim and its evidence the organizing visual system.
directions.creative_signature: A persistent, numbered proof rail intersects the content exactly where an operator must verify a claim.

creative_provenance.observation: The brief asks for a distinctive evidence-first review experience.
creative_provenance.design_implication: Evidence should shape composition and navigation instead of appearing as a generic card or footer.

composition: Use an asymmetric work surface intersected by a numbered proof rail; do not center the primary claim.
spacing_density: Keep the inspection field compact and make the evidence seam the dominant spacing break.
typography: Use a readable editorial text role for claims and a compact tabular utility role for provenance.
color: Use carbon and paper as the working field; reserve signal oxide for provenance state, never decoration.
shape_form: Use square evidence anchors and open content regions rather than a field of rounded cards.
surface_depth: Express hierarchy through seams, rules, and overlap; avoid decorative glass or glow.
imagery: Use owned operational detail only when it proves context; annotate crop and source.
iconography: Use restrained functional symbols paired with explicit evidence labels.
motion: Move the proof rail only to preserve claim-to-source continuity; provide static and reduced-motion equivalents.
voice: Use concrete operator verbs: inspect, compare, resolve, approve.
state_language: Name evidence state directly: inspected, missing, changed, or disputed.
responsive_behavior: Transform the side rail into an inline evidence seam immediately after each claim on narrow screens.

experience_principles: Let an operator verify a claim without losing its context.
experience_architecture: Move from claim, to adjacent proof, to decision, while preserving unresolved evidence in place.
component_patterns: Compose installed controls into a claim-and-proof relationship rather than repeating generic containers.
implementation_guidance: Encode claim, proof, and disposition as semantic roles that survive every viewport and state.
validation_criteria: An operator can identify the project-specific signature and trace a consequential claim to its source within five seconds.
prohibited_patterns: Do not replace the proof rail with a generic bento grid, hero metric, glow, or card stack.
variation_levers: Increase rail prominence for review moments and reduce it to an inline seam for quiet utility states.
tradeoffs: The proof rail reduces simultaneous overview in exchange for stronger claim-to-source continuity.
content_rules: Distinguish inspected, supplied, inferred, and illustrative content and visibly qualify anything not evidenced.
audience_strategy: Explain the evidence relationship in plain language for guided users without slowing expert operators.
prototype_boundaries: Do not imply that unrendered states or unavailable sources were inspected.
